name: Fairmont Chicago Millennium Park
positioning: Large Fairmont city hotel in downtown Chicago with park and lake views, Toro restaurant and Leaf Spa
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Chicago base near Millennium Park
Guests who want a Fairmont Gold lounge stay or a suite with a separate living room

facts.text: The hotel is steps from Millennium Park and Grant Park, shopping on The Magnificent Mile and the Riverwalk.
Guest rooms and suites have views of Lake Michigan, the Chicago skyline and surrounding parks.
Toro, Chef Richard Sandoval's restaurant, serves Latin American flavors throughout the day.
Toro's pan-Latin menu includes ceviche and empanadas.
The lobby bar serves breakfast, coffee and evening drinks.
Leaf Spa offers nature-inspired, holistic treatments that draw inspiration from the seasons.
After treatments, spa guests can use the steam room, meditation room or soaking tub.
Bathrooms have marble finishes, rainfall showers and Le Labo amenities.
The hotel has mobility-accessible rooms with roll-in showers and hearing-accessible rooms with visual alarms.
Guests can get views of Millennium Park or Lake Michigan from Deluxe Cityscape or Signature Parkview rooms.

highlights.text: The Presidential Suite has a library with a fireplace and grand piano, a bar and butler's pantry, and a bedroom with a Jacuzzi bath.
Toro, Chef Richard Sandoval's restaurant, serves Latin American flavors throughout the day.
Leaf Spa offers nature-inspired, holistic treatments that draw inspiration from the seasons.
The Millennium Park two-bedroom suite has two king bedrooms, a separate living room with a pullout sofa and a full kitchenette.
Fairmont Gold rooms and suites include access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge, with hot breakfast and evening snacks.

considerations.text: Access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge comes with booking a Fairmont Gold room or suite.
The hotel hosts a number of special events year-round, from weddings to galas, so it is a busy city hotel with business travelers and families.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning and prime location.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Fairmont Chicago, Millennium Park
